scope: Additive Home Village TH18 Ice Golem death-freeze integration. All earlier frozen references remain unmodified.
game_version: The immutable upstream payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. The most recent independently dated current data consulted is a 2026-09-01 game-file extract processed on 2026-09-03. Supercell's mechanics notes do not identify a current client build.

sources.title: Neue Level & Mehr Balanceänderungen!
sources.limitations: The German official note establishes that a lethal Ice Golem triggers a Freeze spell. It publishes offense durations for L1 through L5 and says offensive Ice Golems retain those original durations with a 36 percent larger freeze radius. It does not publish later-level durations, base radius, propagation, exact eligible-unit classes, or current client build.

sources.title: Full Patch Notes
sources.limitations: The TH15 release table publishes Ice Golem L7 with an 8-second freeze time when destroyed. It does not publish radius, target eligibility, propagation, or a current client build.

sources.title: Ice Golem: levels, costs and times
sources.limitations: The dated extract verifies TH18 maximum L9 and current ordinary troop progression but does not display death-freeze radius or every duration.

sources.title: Ice Golem: Clash of Clans Dark Elixir Troop Stats, Levels & Cost
sources.limitations: Reports L9 offensive death freeze as 9 seconds and says its data comes from game files, but it does not publish a capture date or the freeze radius or complete duration table.

sources.title: Ice Golem
sources.limitations: Provides the reported offensive L1-L9 duration progression and 7.5-tile offensive radius. It does not identify an immutable build, exact expansion timing, precise target classes, or a deterministic client ordering.

death_freeze_radius_tiles.note: Reported offensive radius. The official 2019 note independently establishes a 36 percent offensive increase, but does not publish the base or resulting radius.

support.note: Core creates a serializable Freeze effect at the attacker Ice Golem's death location. It freezes defender-side in-scope entities through the existing Freeze path. Defensive Clan Castle Ice Golems are excluded from this goal and receive no modeled effect.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only ordinary attacks with no death-freeze contract.
changed_values.replacement: L1-L9 offensive death-freeze duration and a reported 7.5-tile offensive radius are imported. An attacker Ice Golem death creates the shared serializable Freeze effect.
changed_values.justification: The official 2019 note establishes the death-triggered Freeze, original offensive duration semantics and increased offensive radius. The official 2023 note independently verifies L7 at eight seconds. Secondary records supply the later-level and radius values that official notes omit.

known_uncertainties: Public sources do not publish a versioned current client contract for freeze propagation, expansion delay, target class, air interaction, attack reset semantics, or intra-tick ordering.
The 7.5-tile radius and L6/L8 duration values are secondary. L9 is corroborated by a secondary game-file-backed page but no dated source exposes its exact field capture.

This increment intentionally applies only attacker Ice Golem deaths and freezes defender-side in-scope entities through the existing Freeze effect. Clan Castle reinforcements are excluded, and the exact treatment of any excluded defender-side unit types remains open.
The Viewer uses the existing Freeze-effect visual. No separate Ice Golem death animation or source-verified propagation visual is claimed.
conclusion: Ice Golem is executable through shared Core, CLI, Viewer and RL paths with a sourced death-triggered Freeze. It remains partial until a versioned propagation and target-selection contract is available.
